_meta.name: poisson_glm
_meta.description: Poisson regression: REG_GLM with family poisson and link log, for a non-negative count whose mean grows multiplicatively with the predictors; exp(coefficient) is the rate ratio per unit. Sibling of the binomial logit (04_logistic.json). customers.pulse has no count field, so age stands in as the count and income as the predictor (no effect here, p about 0.05).
